subject: financial_literacy
concept: Writing a complete simple business plan combining problem/solution, startup costs, pricing/margin, funding strategy, and cash flow awareness, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a complete business plan outline covering all major components from this unit
exercise.abstract: Student writes a complete simple business plan for an original idea, addressing every major component from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan addresses all major components (problem/solution, costs, pricing, funding, cash flow) coherently
misconception_flags: plan addresses some components thoroughly while omitting others entirely

interest_binding: business idea generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
